value = critic(state)
with torch.no_grad():
    next_value = critic(next_state) * (0 if terminated else 1)
    td_target = reward + gamma * next_value
td_error = td_target - value

actor_loss  = -log_prob * td_error.detach()
critic_loss = td_error.pow(2)
caption: The actor treats delta_t as a weight; it does not backprop through the critic
